title: Aramco administrative building in Riyadh damaged in attempted Houthi attack
detail: An Aramco administrative tower in Riyadh's financial district was damaged on Nov 8. The coalition said it intercepted two ballistic missiles launched toward Riyadh; the Energy Ministry attributed limited damage to falling debris and reported no casualties. Eyewitness and imagery reports suggested more serious facade damage than the ministry's wording. The Houthis are reported to have claimed the attack.
